```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP")) CAP <- "Conditional demand in terms of %s PPV at $D=%d$ m per MIC."
if (!exists("RESP")) RESP <- c(ppvL = "longitudinal", ppvT = "transversal", ppvV = "vertical", ppv = "resultant")
if (!exists("D.set")) D.set <- seq(100L, 500L, 50L)
```

::: {.panel-tabset .full-width}

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| include: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
for (.D in D.set) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### $D=%d\\ m$\n\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n", .D))
  for (.ID in names(RESP)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n#### $%s$\n\n", .ID))
    NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_fig/conditional.PPV.cell.qmd",
                   stem = sprintf("fcond-D%d-%s", .D, .ID),
                   labels = "rewrite",
                   vars = list(ID = .ID, D_TARGET = .D,
                               CAPTION = sprintf(CAP, RESP[[.ID]], .D)),
                   root = root)
  }
  cat("\n:::\n")
}
```

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(CAP, RESP, D.set)
```
